newsItems.title: Courtesy Visit to the Edo State Commissioner of Health
newsItems.excerpt: The Progressive Executives of FAPSSA paid a courtesy visit to the Honourable Commissioner of Health, Dr. Cyril Adams Oshiomhole.
newsItems.body:
COURTESY VISIT TO THE HONOURABLE COMMISSIONER OF HEALTH, EDO STATE - DR. CYRIL ADAMS OSHIOMHOLE
BY THE PROGRESSIVE EXECUTIVES OF FAPSSA*

The Executive Council of FAPSSA, led by The Progressive Governor, Comr. Obi-Ihemeje Onyeka, paid a courtesy visit to the Honourable Commissioner of Health, Edo State, Dr. Cyril Adams Oshiomhole.

Present during the visit were members of the Progressive Executive and other faculty stakeholders.

During the meeting, the Governor, on behalf of the Executive Council and the entire students of the Faculty of Physical Sciences, appreciated the Honourable Commissioner for his continuous efforts towards improving the healthcare system within Edo State, including the renovation of Primary Healthcare Centres and the promotion of health awareness programs across different sectors.

The Executive Council also discussed important issues concerning youth development through the healthcare system, particularly in relation to Mental Health Awareness Month.
newsItems.imageAlt: FAPSSA Progressive Executives courtesy visit to the Edo State Commissioner of Health

newsItems.title: Student Creative Experience 1.0
newsItems.excerpt: A free student development initiative exploring graphic design, smartphone photography and AI YouTube storytelling.
newsItems.body:
🚀 FACULTY OF PHYSICAL SCIENCES STUDENTS, THIS IS FOR YOU!

The Office of the Secretary General, Faculty of Physical Sciences Association (FAPSSA), University of Benin proudly presents:

🔥 STUDENT CREATIVE EXPERIENCE 1.0
Empowering Students Through Smartphone Creativity

📅 Date: Tuesday, June 9th – Friday, June 12th
🎟️ Participation Fee: FREE

This initiative is specially designed for FAPSSA students who are ready to explore creativity, innovation, and digital opportunities using just their smartphones.

✨ What You Will Learn:
🎨 Graphic Design — Flyers, posters, social media designs, and more.
📸 Photography — Professional smartphone photography techniques.
🎬 AI YouTube Storytelling — Faceless AI videos, scripts, thumbnails, voiceovers, and more.

newsItems.title: Happy World Environment Day
newsItems.excerpt: FAPSSA marks World Environment Day and encourages everyone to reduce waste, reuse materials and recycle plastics.
newsItems.body:
FACULTY OF PHYSICAL SCIENCES STUDENTS' ASSOCIATION, (FAPSSA)

🌍 Happy World Environment Day! ♻️

Today, we join the world in celebrating the beauty and importance of our environment. Every small action we take reducing waste, reusing materials, and recycling plastics, contributes to a cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable future for generations to come.

As we commemorate this year's World Environment Day, let us all embrace the responsibility of protecting our planet by making environmentally conscious choices every day.

Together, we can beat plastic pollution and create a greener world for all. 🌱💚

Happy World Environment Day!

🏥💙 FAPSSA Health Day Is Here! 💙🏥

newsItems.title: FAPSSA Most Popular Contest 2026 – Winner
newsItems.excerpt: FAPSSA congratulates Amasowomwan Promise of Statistics, 400 Level, on winning the 2026 Most Popular Contest with 2,165 votes.
newsItems.body:
🏆 FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER

FAPSSA MOST POPULAR CONTEST 2026

OFFICIAL CONGRATULATORY MESSAGE

The Faculty of Physical Sciences Students' Association (FAPSSA) heartily congratulates Amasowomwan Promise of the Department of Statistics (400 Level) on emerging as the Winner of the FAPSSA Most Popular Contest 2026.

After an exciting and highly competitive voting process, Amasowomwan Promise secured a remarkable 2,165 votes, earning the prestigious title of FAPSSA Most Popular 2026.

Your victory is a reflection of the tremendous support, admiration, and confidence reposed in you by the students of the Faculty of Physical Sciences.

We also extend our appreciation to all the finalists and every student who participated by voting and making this contest a success.

Once again, congratulations to Amasowomwan Promise, our FAPSSA Most Popular 2026. We wish you continued success and excellence in all your future endeavors.

Congratulations! 🎉
newsItems.imageAlt: FAPSSA Most Popular Contest 2026 congratulatory announcement
